bundle.shortDescription: Horizon and Calendar for your own time
bundle.longDescription: A private, local-first time system: a nonlinear Horizon and a Calendar over your fixed events, real deadlines, and optional plans. Reads Trace, Quercus, Google, and Outlook calendars without writing back.
